user.title: Select Solar Inverter Provider
user.description: Choose your solar inverter platform. Solmate connects directly to your inverter's cloud or local API.

credentials.title: Sunsynk / Deye Cloud Login
credentials.description: Enter the email and password you use to log in to Sunsynk Connect or Solmate app.

solaredge.title: SolarEdge Monitoring Credentials
solaredge.description: Enter your SolarEdge Site ID and Monitoring API Key.

victron.title: Victron Energy VRM Credentials
victron.description: Enter your Victron VRM Installation / Site ID and Personal Access Token.

tesla.title: Tesla Powerwall Local Gateway
tesla.description: Enter the local IP address or hostname of your Tesla Powerwall Gateway.

foxess.title: FoxESS Cloud Open API
foxess.description: Enter your FoxESS Device Serial Number and Open API Key.

goodwe.title: GoodWe SEMS Portal Login
goodwe.description: Enter your GoodWe SEMS Portal account email and password.

growatt.title: Growatt ShineServer Login
growatt.description: Enter your Growatt ShineServer username and password.

enphase.title: Enphase IQ / Envoy Gateway
enphase.description: Enter your local Envoy Gateway IP address or hostname.

solarman.title: Solarman Open API Credentials
solarman.description: Enter your Solarman Developer App ID, App Secret, and Station ID.
